mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member_invite WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT mi.id AS invite_id, mi.invite_code, mi.inviter_id, mi.invitee_phone, mi.invitee_email, mi.role_id, mi.status AS invite_status, mi.used_by, mi.used_time, mi.expire_time, mi.create_time, COALESCE(r.role_code, '') AS role_code, COALESCE(r.role_name, '') AS role_name, COALESCE(ui.name, '') AS inviter_name, COALESCE(uu.name, '') AS used_by_name FROM member_invite mi LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = mi.role_id AND r.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN sys_user ui ON ui.id = mi.inviter_id AND ui.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN sys_user uu ON uu.id = mi.used_by AND uu.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE mi.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND mi.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY mi.create_time DESC, mi.id DESC
